competences: The learner identifies Surat An-Nas as a chapter of the Holy Qur’an.
The learner recites all six verses with correct articulation.
languageCompetence: Pronounces and reads: Surat An-Nas, Qul a'oozu birabbin naas, Malikin naas, Ilaahin naas.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to identify Surat An-Nas on the chart.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to recite the six verses correctly.
priorKnowledge: Learners have heard prayers and recitations in Islamic Religious Education, which this lesson builds upon.
methods: I do, we do, you do
materials: Chart showing the six transliterated verses of Surat An-Nas
references: NCDC IRE P.1 TEACHERS RESOURCE BOOK

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher asks learners to name the surah shown on the chart, points to its six verses and introduces Surat An-Nas. The teacher asks: 'Recite the Surat'
steps.learnerActivity: Learners look at the displayed chart, name the surah and recall the six verses with the teacher.

source.quote: Display a chart with the Surat

steps.content: Surat An-Nas has six verses; Qul a'oozu birabbin naas; Malikin naas; Ilaahin naas.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays Surat An-Nas and explains that it has six verses. The teacher recites the opening verse clearly and asks learners to repeat it. The teacher points to the relevant verses on the chart.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners follow the verses on the chart, repeat the words clearly and take turns responding to the teacher.

steps.content: Qul a'oozu birabbin naas; Malikin naas; Ilaahin naas; Min sharril waswaasil khannaas; Allazee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin naas; Minal jinnati wannaas
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher recites all six verses from the chart and asks the class, groups and individual learners to repeat each verse with correct articulation. The teacher invites learners to practise individually while listening to their pronunciation.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recite or read the verses together and individually, then repeat the words that need clearer articulation.

steps.content: Recite the Surat; Reciting the surah (chapter) in groups, pairs and individually; Reciting Surat An-Nas (1-6 verses)
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher sets the sourced tasks: 'Recite the Surat', 'Reciting the surah (chapter) in groups, pairs and individually', and 'Reciting Surat An-Nas (1-6 verses)'. The teacher checks each learner's performance.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners complete the three oral tasks in pairs and individually, repeating the verses and answering the teacher.

source.quote: Reciting the surah (chapter) in groups, pairs and individually

steps.content: I can recite Surat An-Nas; I can read Surat An-Nas.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher invites three learners to recite or read the six verses and asks the class to check the correct order. The teacher gives feedback.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners listen to the three recitations, correct their pronunciation with guidance, and read the verses together.

source.quote: Assess as the learner reads Surat Annas

assessment: Assess learners through the sourced activities 'Recite the Surat', 'Reciting the surah (chapter) in groups, pairs and individually' and 'Reciting Surat An-Nas (1-6 verses)'. Check correct pronunciation, reading order and understanding.
homework: Practise reciting and reading the six verses of Surat An-Nas each day.
